# apipbx_voicemail_group (Resource)

A voicemail group: a message left for its number (or a route that sends callers to it) goes to every mailbox in it. Import with "<tenant id>/<id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `boxes` (List of String) Voicemail box ids; a message left for the group goes to each of them.
- `name` (String)
- `number` (String) Dialable; shares the number space with extensions, ring groups, queues and conferences.
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
